The fact that you have received other job offers was the second-biggest factor, also pulling the prediction toward departure. Finally, your relatively short 1-5 years in your current role (compared to longer stays among those predicted to stay) added further weight toward leaving, suggesting you may still be evaluating whether this organization is the right long-term fit.

Taken together, these elements created a clear signal that you are at high risk of exiting. The organization should consider discussing your career goals with you openly and exploring ways to increase your sense of stability and growth here. You may want to reflect on what would make you want to stay long-term. Addressing these points could change the outlook for both sides. (248 words)
